name: hollocou
reference: Hollocou, Bonald, Lelarge & Lemonnier. A Streaming Algorithm for Graph Clustering. NeurIPS workshop, 2017. (streamcom)

vmax.doc: Maximum community volume. The sole granularity knob: larger vmax yields fewer, coarser communities. streamcom's built-in default is 3 (micro-communities); 10000 matches the value used in prior benchmarking and is the Protocol A default. Swept as the granularity knob in Protocol B.

condition.doc: Aggregation condition when merging: 0 requires both community volumes to stay under vmax (AND), 1 requires either (OR). streamcom defaults to 0 (AND); set-only, not a tuned hyperparameter.
